exit 0
--- stdout
Launch adversarial-pairing doer/reviewer sessions in WezTerm panes
Usage:
liza launch wezterm adversarial-pairing <blackboard-path> [flags]
Flags:
--class string WezTerm window class (default depends on launch type)
--cwd string working directory for launched panes (default: current Liza project for MAS, current directory for pairing)
--doer-cli string coding CLI for the doer session (default "codex")
--dry-run print the wezterm command without launching it
--goal string create the blackboard with this goal when it does not exist
-h, --help help for adversarial-pairing
--prompt-delay duration delay before injecting adversarial-pairing prompts into WezTerm panes (default 2s)
--reviewer stringArray reviewer CLI or id=cli; repeat for multiple reviewers (default: codex, codex-2=codex)
--workspace string WezTerm workspace name (defaults to --class)
--yolo pass yolo to the doer adversarial-pairing invocation
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
